description: A two-stage editing workflow that starts with reversible preview changes and advances to comprehensive revisions only with approval.

defaultPrompt: Start a temporary editing preview of this content.
Show the proposed changes and let me approve comprehensive editing.
Revert the temporary edit and restore the original.
interface.longDescription: Stage temporary and reversible changes, review differences, and only then perform comprehensive editing with explicit authorization and a preserved original.

name: transient-to-comprehensive-editor
